**Performance: pass-with-notes** at `b69cf96b6a6b6e9938f40a35f66ba66113fb4f52`.

One-commit delta from [round 3](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/pull/170#issuecomment-6715411679), governance `4b0dcb9`. P170-F001 remains closed; the soft/per-child timeout qualification P170-N001 stands.

**No launch added or repeated.** `quiet` replaces `must` for the worktree/seat inventories and invokes the same runner once. The gh/status guards inspect the stderr already returned by their existing commands. Trimming, first-line extraction and diagnostics cost O(stderr bytes); there is no retry, inventory reread, new process, timer or daemon mutation.

Nonempty **trimmed** stderr on worktree/seat inventories refuses before removal; on gh it leaves that PR's state unusable, and on status it spares the candidate. This can reduce subsequent work/removal calls, not increase them. The warning-free macOS direct-call model remains **3 + P + C + R**, with the same single lsof/seat snapshots and cached absolute executable paths. Non-macOS prune still refuses before resolution or child/daemon calls.

**CI:** [42433237523](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42433237523) succeeds at this exact SHA. Node **22 and 24 each execute 33 pr-freeze tests**. Read the new case: exit-zero/empty-stdout git status with an unreadable warning causes no removal; gh warnings spare; worktree/seat warnings refuse; a no-warning positive control removes. These are injected command results, not a live unreadable-filesystem run. The supplied mutation claim was not rerun locally. Typecheck/Biome and Rust checks succeed; Delivers `42433238035` succeeds, while its cancelled duplicate is not proof.

Worktree and GitHub heads agree; clean and CLEAN/MERGEABLE. No local build, test, mutation, live dry-run, cwd census or prune. No new performance blocker; separate correctness/security review remains independent.
